summary: Verified the mobile nav CSS fix on AUDINEXA. Mobile (390x844): bottom nav renders as a HORIZONTAL bar with all 5 tabs (home/sched/patients/billing/reports) sharing y=785.5px and monotonically increasing x-coords (8, 83.6, 159.2, 234.8, 310.4), each ~71.6px wide with icon+label stacked vertically. Desktop sidebar hidden (display:none). Mobile drawer NOT in DOM initially; hamburger visible; tapping hamburger renders app-nav-mobile; tapping backdrop closes it. Bottom-nav routes navigate to /billing and /reports and active tab gets text-cyan-600 class. Desktop (1440x900): app-nav display:flex, mobile-bottom-nav display:none, mobile-nav-toggle display:none. Founder login (founder@audinexa.com/founder123) works. All acceptance criteria PASSED.

issues: Recharts warnings in console: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic; suggests a ResponsiveContainer parent has 0 dimensions on first render. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts container width/height=-1 warnings on dashboard load — check ResponsiveContainer parent min-height.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile bottom-nav fix (.bottomnav-grid class in index.css bypassing the global grid-cols-5 override) is verified working on iPhone-size viewport. AppShell mobile/desktop split via hidden md:flex / md:hidden is correct. Founder auto-login works, no OTP wall.
rca of the issue: Verified pass — root cause (global @media max-width:640px collapsing .grid.grid-cols-5 to 1 col) is bypassed by the new .bottomnav-grid class which hardcodes grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)).
